# Unipile Documentation

> Unipile API  Transform your app into a powerful communication hub using our easy-to-integrate Email, Calendar, and Messaging APIs.

## Documentation: Getting started
- [Welcome](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/welcome.md): Unipile is the Unified API to interact with messaging, mailing, calendar and social services from popular platforms.
- [Fundamentals](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/fundamentals.md): This guide provides a mental map of the fundamental concepts and workflow to start using Unipile.
- [Quickstart](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/quickstart.md): Learn how to get Unipile set up in your project and make your first requests with a Provider. The setup is the same for every provider.
  - [LinkedIn](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/linkedin-quickstart.md): Learn how to list chats of a Linkedin account and send a message in one of them using Unipile SDK.
  - [WhatsApp](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/whatsapp-quickstart.md): Learn how to list chats of a WhatsApp account and send a message in one of them using Unipile SDK.
  - [Telegram](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/telegram-quickstart.md): Learn how to list chats of a Telegram account and send a message in one of them using Unipile SDK.
  - [Gmail](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/gmail-quickstart.md): Learn how to list emails of a Gmail account and send emails using Unipile SDK.
  - [Outlook](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/outlook-quickstart.md): Learn how to list emails of an Outlook inbox and send emails using Unipile SDK.
  - [IMAP](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/imap-quickstart.md): Learn how to list emails of an IMAP account and send emails using Unipile SDK.
  - [Facebook](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/facebook-quickstart.md): Learn how to list chats of a Facebook account and send a message in one of them using Unipile SDK.
- [Migration from v1](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-from-v1.md)
  - [Transfer Accounts & Subscription](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/transfer-accounts-subscription.md): This guide explains how to transfer your existing V1 subscription to V2 and optionally migrate your accounts and settings.
  - [Migrate your codebase](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migrate-codebase-from-v1.md)
    - [Authentication & Accounts](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-auth-and-accounts.md): This migration guide will help you migrate from v1 accounts to v2 accounts regarding authentication flows and connection managment.
    - [Users API](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-users-api.md): This guide will help you migrate the Users features of your application to API v2.
    - [Posts API](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-posts-api.md): This guide will help you migrate the Posts features of your application to API v2.
    - [Calendar API](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-calendar-api.md): This guide will help you migrate the Calendar features of your application to API v2.
    - [Email API](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-emails-api.md): This guide will help you migrate the Emailing features of your application to API v2.
    - [Messaging API](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-messaging-api.md): This guide will help you migrate the Messaging features of your application to API v2.
    - [LinkedIn API](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-linkedin-api.md): This guide will help you migrate the LinkedIn features of your application to API v2.
    - [Webhooks](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/migration-webhooks.md)
- [Model context protocol (MCP)](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/mcp.md): Connect your AI tools to Unipile using MCP
- [Automation tools](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/automation-tools.md): Automation platforms such as n8n, Make, and Zapier allow you to connect different services and automate workflows between them. These tools are commonly used to build integrations without writing…
  - [n8n](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/n8n.md): Learn how to create workflows using Unipile with n8n.
  - [Make.com](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/make-com.md): Learn how to create scenarios using Unipile with Make.com.
  - [Zapier](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/zapier.md): Learn how to create scenarios using Unipile with Zapier.

## Documentation: Learn Unipile
- [Platform Management](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/platform-management.md): Manage your Unipile workspace, applications, and billing settings.
  - [Dashboard Guide](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/dashboard.md): Find your way around the Dashboard and choose a setup path for your integration.
  - [Organizations](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/organizations.md): Create organizations, manage members and roles, and require two-factor authentication.
  - [Applications](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/applications.md): Create and manage applications, environments, and application settings.
  - [User Account and Security](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/user-account-security.md): Manage your Dashboard login methods, password, two-factor authentication, and user account.
  - [Hosted Auth Settings](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/hosted-auth-settings.md): Configure Hosted Auth branding, displayed consent permissions, support links, and domains.
  - [Scopes](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/scopes.md): Isolate connected accounts and control which accounts each API key can access.
  - [Custom Domains](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/custom-domains.md): Verify and enable your own domains for Hosted Auth and email tracking.
  - [Billing](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/billing.md): Understand how Unipile billing works with pay-as-you-go pricing based on connected accounts.
- [Provider Accounts](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/provider-accounts.md): Accounts & Providers are a fundamental part of Unipile, here is the starting point to learn everything about them.
  - [Link an Account](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/link-an-account.md): To start using the API, the user must first authenticate with a provider. Once authenticated, the account is linked to Unipile, allowing you to interact with it through the API. There is a multiple…
  - [Advanced Authentication](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/advanced-authentication.md): Generate customized account connection and reconnection links from the Dashboard.
  - [Manage Provider Accounts](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/manage-provider-accounts.md): Inspect connected accounts, reconnect them, and manage their metadata, Scopes, and automatic proxies in the Dashboard.
  - [Connection Status](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/status-lifecycle.md): The connection status indicates whether Unipile can access data from the provider. Once an account is linked, it is considered operational and begins operating normally. However, certain expected…
  - [Initial Sync](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/initial-sync.md): Understanding the initial download of all historical data when an account is linked to Unipile.
  - [Proxies](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/proxies.md): In Unipile, a proxy is a secure intermediary that routes requests between Unipile and external providers. When interacting with an Account, requests don’t have to go directly from Unipile’s servers…
  - [Configure OAuth](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/configure-oauth.md): Learn how to configure production-ready OAuth flows for supported providers.
    - [Permissions required](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/oauth-permissions.md): Choose Google and Microsoft OAuth scopes for the Methods API and realtime events you use.
    - [Register with Google](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/google-oauth.md): To connect Google accounts to Unipile via OAuth authentication, you need to register your app in Google Cloud Console. You will then configure Unipile to use your Google application ID. If you…
    - [Register with Microsoft](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/microsoft-oauth.md): To connect Microsoft accounts to Unipile via OAuth authentication, you need to register your app in Azure Active Directory (AAD). You will then configure Unipile to use your AAD application ID. If…
- [Methods](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/methods.md): Methods are API Endpoints that provide access to read, write, and update many types of resources from the Provider.
  - [Authenticate Requests](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/api-keys.md): Create, secure, and use API Keys to authenticate requests to Unipile.
  - [Manage Cache](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/caching.md): Improve performance and reduce rate limit hits with Unipile's built-in caching. Learn what is cached, how invalidation works, and how to control cache per request.
  - [Rate Limits](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/rate-limits.md): Understand how Unipile enforces rate limiting to protect your integrations and stay within provider constraints. Learn how rules apply to methods, error handling, and configuration.
  - [Provider's Restrictions](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/provider-limits-and-restrictions.md): It's crucial to understand and manage the limits and restrictions imposed by each provider to ensure smooth operation of your applications. Below are the limitations and guidelines for interacting…
- [Realtime](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/realtime.md): Use webhooks to receive real-time notifications about events occurring on connected accounts.
  - [Introduction to webhooks](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/webhooks-introduction.md): Use webhooks to notify your application about realtime events in connected accounts.
  - [Configure a webhook](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/configure-a-webhook.md): Learn how to configure a new webhook and start receiving events in your app.
  - [Test and Debug Webhooks](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/test-debug-webhooks.md): Simulate events and provider failures, inspect delivery logs, and replay stored events from the Dashboard.

## Documentation: Integration guides
- [Provider Authentication](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/provider-authentication.md): Integration guides for Unipile’s programmatic provider authentication options.
  - [Hosted Authentication](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/authenticate-with-hosted-auth.md): Learn how to let your users authenticate to their accounts from your application using the Hosted Auth wizard.
  - [Custom Authentication](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/authenticate-with-custom-auth.md): Learn how to integrate a full authentication flow within your application.
    - [Credentials Flow](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/credentials-flow.md): Integrate authentication for provider that accepts a set of credentials—such as a username and password, tokens, or connection parameters. During this process, the provider may also require the user…
    - [QR Code Flow](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/qr-code-flow.md): Integrate authentication for provider that requires a QR code to be scanned. A QR code have a short living time and must be refreshed when expired. Read on to implement this flow.
    - [OAuth Flow](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/docs/oauth-flow.md): Integrate authentication for provider that use a standard OAuth flow.

## API Reference: Api reference
- [API Usage](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/api-usage.md): Understand general concepts, response codes, and authentication strategies.
- [Error responses](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/error-responses.md): Troubleshoot problems with this comprehensive breakdown of all error codes.
- [Caching](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/cache.md): Unipile improves your application's performance and prevent hits of rate limiting by caching methods requests.  This page provides an in-depth look at Unipile caching mechanisms and the how to…
- [Rate limit](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/rate-limit.md): Rate limit information is returned through response headers, allowing clients to monitor the active rate limit window and adjust request throughput accordingly.
- [Event types](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/event-types-1.md): This is a list of all the types of events we currently send.

## API Reference: Provider authentication
- Hosted Auth
  - [Create Auth Link](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/createauthlink.md): Create a link to the hosted authentication wizard for the user to authenticate with the provider.
- Custom Auth
  - [Start Auth Intent](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/startauthintent.md): Start an auth intent for a provider. This might require handling of checkpoints and oauth flows depending on the provider. Use <a…
  - [Solve a Checkpoint](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/solvecheckpoint.md): Solve the current checkpoint for the given authentication intent.
  - [Request Checkpoint](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/requestcheckpoint.md): Request a checkpoint for the given authentication intent. This can be used to request a different type of checkpoint if the first one was not successful.
  - [Resend Checkpoint Notification or Code](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/resendcheckpoint.md): Resend the notification or code for the current checkpoint of the given authentication intent. Use Request Checkpoint to request a different checkpoint.

## API Reference: Methods
- Messaging
  - Chats
    - [Get a Chat Picture](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getchatpicture.md): Downloads the picture of the specified Chat, for the providers that publish no public url for it. The url of this endpoint is given by the `private_picture_download_url` field of a Chat.
    - [Start a Chat](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/startchat.md): Starts a new 1to1 or group chat by sending the first message.       Use <a href="https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/sendmessage">Send a Message</a> if a conversation already exist with the…
    - [List all Chats](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getchatslist.md): Returns a list of account's chats, whatever the inbox they belong to. The chats are returned sorted by their last message date, with the most recent appearing first.       You might want to use the…
    - [Get a Chat](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getchat.md): Retrieves a Chat object.
    - [Get a User Chat](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getuserchat.md): Resolves chat identifiers associated with the specified User. Depending on the provider, the result may include chats with or without message history, and may return multiple matches across inboxes…
    - [Update a Chat](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/updatechat.md): Updates the specified chat by setting the values of the parameters passed. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged.
    - [Accept a Chat Request](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/acceptchatrequest.md): Accepts a chat request from an inbox that contains pending conversations.
    - [Delete a Chat](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/deletechat.md): Deletes a chat if supported by the provider.
    - [List all Inboxes](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getinboxeslist.md): Returns a list of the account's Inboxes.
    - [Start a Chat from Inbox](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/startchatfrominbox.md): Starts a new 1to1 or group chat in the given inbox by sending the first message.       Use <a href="https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/sendmessage">Send a Message</a> if a conversation…
    - [List Inbox Chats](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getinboxchatslist.md): Returns a list of account's chats from a specific inbox.       The chats are returned sorted by their last message date, with the most recent appearing first.       Filters are applied with an AND…
  - Messages
    - [Send a Message](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/sendmessage.md): Sends a message in the specified chat.       Use <a href="https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/startchat">Start a Chat</a> or <a…
    - [List all Chat Messages](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getmessageslist.md): Returns a list of messages in a chat. The messages are returned sorted by their timestamp, with the most recent appearing first.
    - [Get a Message](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getmessage.md): Retrieves a message object.
    - [Get a Message Attachment](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getattachment.md): Download the attachment file of a message.
    - [Forward a Message](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/forwardmessage.md): Forwards a message to another chat.
    - [Modify a Message](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/modifymessage.md): Modifies one of the account's owner messages.       Trying to modify the message of another user will fail.
    - [Read a Message](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/readmessage.md): Marks a message sent in the chat by another user as read by you.         Trying to mark your own messages as read will fail.         This does not affect the read status of the chat. Use <a…
    - [Pin a Message](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/pinmessage.md): Pins the specified message at the top of its chat, or unpins it, if supported by the provider.       Pinning the message of another user is allowed, but providers might require an admin role or some…
    - [Delete a Message](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/deletemessage.md): Deletes one of your own messages. Depending of the provider, the message might still be visible as deleted.       Trying to delete the message of another user will fail.
  - Group Participants
    - [Add a Chat Participant](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/addparticipant.md): Adds a new user as participant of chat if you have the rights to. Providers might requires an admin role or some permissions.       Trying to add a participant into a 1to1 chat can fail depending on…
    - [Remove a Chat Participant](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/removeparticipant.md): Removes a participant user from a chat if you have the rights to. Providers might requires an admin role or some permissions.       Trying to remove a participant from a 1to1 chat will fail.
    - [List all Chat Participants](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getparticipantslist.md): Returns a list of participants in the specified group chat. For 1to1 chats, the unique participant is given in the chat object.       Trying to retrieve the list of participants of a 1to1 chat will…
  - Message Reactions
    - [Add a Message Reaction](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/addmessagereaction.md): Adds a reaction to a message. Some providers only allow the use of a limited list of emojis, trying to react with an unsupported emoji will fail.
    - [Remove a Message Reaction](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/removemessagereaction.md): Removes a reaction of the account's owner from a message.       Trying to remove a reaction from another user will fail.
    - [List all Message's Reactions](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getmessagereactionslist.md): Returns the list of reactions made to a message. Reaction counts are given with the Message object. This is useful to show a detailed list of all reactions and their author.
  - Status
    - [Get a User Presence](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getuserpresence.md): Returns whether the specified User is currently online, identified by the id returned by the provider. Only supported by Instagram, LinkedIn, Telegram and WhatsApp. A User whose provider reports no…
    - [Set Presence](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/setpresence.md): Sets the presence of the user.
    - [Set Composing Status](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/setcomposingstatus.md): Sets the composing status of the user in a chat.
- Users
  - Profiles
    - [Get a User Profile](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getuserprofile.md): Retrieves the specified User profile. Use `me` as `user_id` to specify the owner of the connected account.
    - [Update a User Profile](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/updateuserprofile.md): Partially updates the specified User profile. Use `me` as `user_id` to update the account owner profile. Omitted properties remain unchanged; supplied values replace existing values; empty strings…
    - [Report a Profile Visit](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/visituserprofile.md): Report to the provider that you have visited a given user profile. This can be used to simulate engagement and activity.
  - Relations / Follows
    - [Unblock a User](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/unblockuser.md): Unblocks a user previously blocked by the account owner. Unblocking a User that is not blocked has no effect. The `is_blocked` field of the User profile reflects the result.       LIMITATIONS: On…
    - [Block a User](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/blockuser.md): Blocks a user on behalf of the account owner. A blocked User can no longer contact the account owner. Blocking an already blocked User has no effect. The `is_blocked` field of the User profile…
    - [List Relations of a User](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getuserrelations.md): Returns a list of bi-directional relations for the specified User. Use `me` as `user_id` to specify the owner of the connected account.
    - [List all pending Relation / Follow requests](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getrelationrequestslist.md): Returns a list of pending relation / follow requests that have been sent or received by the owner of the account.
    - [Send a Relation request](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/createrelationrequest.md): Sends a bi-directional relation request to a user. Trying to send a relation request to an existing relation will fail. For uni-directional relations, use `Follow User` instead.
    - [Cancel or Refuse a Relation / Follow request](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/cancelrelationrequest.md): Cancels the relation / follow request if sent by the owner of the account to another user. Refuses the relation / follow request if received by the owner of the account from another user.
    - [Accept a Relation request](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/acceptrelationrequest.md): Accepts a received relation request from another user. Trying to accept a sent relation request will fail.
    - [List Followers of a User](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listuserfollowers.md): Returns a list of followers of the specified User. Set `me` as `user_id` to specify the owner of the connected account.
    - [List Following of a User](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listuserfollowing.md): Returns a list of Users followed by the specified User. Set `me` as `user_id` to specify the owner of the connected account. On LinkedIn, only the literal value `me` is supported for `user_id`; other…
    - [Follow a User](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/followuser.md): Follows a user. Trying to follow an already followed User will fail. For bi-directional relations, use `Send Relation Request` instead. If the User has a private profile, this will create a Follow…
    - [Unfollow a User](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/unfollowuser.md): Unfollows a user. Trying to unfollow a not followed User will fail.
    - [Delete a Relation](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/deleterelation.md): Deletes a bi-directional relation with another user. For uni-directional relations, use `Unfollow User` instead.
  - Contacts
    - [List contacts](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getcontactslist.md): Returns a list of contacts for the connected account. Served by the email provider for email accounts and by the messaging provider for messaging accounts (e.g. WhatsApp). On providers where a…
  - [Get a User Picture](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getuserpicture.md): Downloads the profile picture of the specified User. Use `me` as `user_id` to specify the owner of the connected account. For the providers that publish no public url for it, the url of this endpoint…

  - [Send an Email](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/sendemail.md): Sends an Email to the recipients in the `to`, `cc`, and `bcc`.<br/><br/>Multipart supported, refer to <a href="https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/api-usage#sending-files">Sending Files</a>.

    - [Add Comment to a Post](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/addpostcomment.md): Adds a comment to a post.       LIMITATIONS: On Facebook, a comment takes one image; an animated GIF file is published as a still image.<br/><br/>Multipart supported, refer to <a…
    - [Update a Comment](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/updatepostcomment.md): Updates an existing comment.
    - [Delete Comment from a Post](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/deletepostcomment.md): Deletes a comment of the account's owner from a post. Trying to delete a comment from another user will fail.
    - [List all Comment's Replies](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getpostcommentreplieslist.md): Returns the list of replies to a comment. The replies are returned sorted by their creation date, with the most recent appearing first.       LIMITATIONS: On Facebook, the page size is set by…
    - [Reply to a Comment](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/replytocomment.md): Replies to a particular comment.       LIMITATIONS: On Facebook, a comment takes one image; an animated GIF file is published as a still image.<br/><br/>Multipart supported, refer to <a…
    - [List all Comment's Reactions](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getpostcommentreactionslist.md): Returns the list of reactions made to a comment. Reaction counts are given with the Comment object. This is useful to show a detailed list of all reactions and their author.       LIMITATIONS: On…
    - [Add Reaction to a Comment](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/addpostcommentreaction.md): Adds a reaction to a post.
    - [Remove Reaction from a Comment](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/removepostcommentreaction.md): Removes a reaction of the account's owner from a comment. Trying to remove a reaction from another user will fail.

## API Reference: Methods (specifics)
- LinkedIn
  - [Get Job Slots Credits](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getrecruiterjobslotscredits.md): Retrieves current contract Job slots credits.
  - [Get InMail Credits](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getinmailcredits.md): Retrieves InMail credits by service or for all subscribed services.
  - [List Available Contracts](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getavailablecontracts.md): Returns a list of Recruiter/Sales Navigator contracts associated with your account.
  - [Select a Contract](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/selectcontract.md): Activates a given Recruiter/Sales Navigator contract on your account.
  - [Perform a Request to any LinkedIn API Endpoint](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/proxyrequest.md): Allows advanced users to implement any LinkedIn feature that is not yet supported by our platform.
  - [List Profile Views](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getprofileviews.md): Returns a list of users who recently viewed your profile, along with a range of analytics data.       Non-premium users will only have access to a limited amount of data, and search filters will be…
  - Classic Member
    - [Endorse a Member's Skill](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/endorseclassicmemberskill.md): Validates a given skill for one of your relations.
  - Classic Company
    - [Get Company Follow Request Credits](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getcompanyfollowinvitationcredits.md): Retrieves the remaining credits for inviting members to follow a LinkedIn company page.
    - [Invite Members to Follow a Company](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/sendcompanyfollowinvitation.md): Sends a request to one or more users to follow a LinkedIn company page administered by the account.
    - [List Managed Company Pages](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getmanagedcompanypages.md): Returns a list of company pages for which the account user is an administrator.
    - [Get a Company Profile](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getclassiccompanyprofile.md): Retrieves the specified company profile.
    - [Verify Company Member Identity](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/verifyclassiccompanymemberidentity.md): Verifies member identity by submitting an email address.
    - [Submit Otp Verification Code](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/submitclassiccompanyotpcode.md): Completes the process of member identity verification.
  - Classic Search
    - [List Search Parameters](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getclassicsearchparameters.md): Returns a list of parameters to be used in the search route.
    - [Perform People Search](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/performclassicpeoplesearch.md): Returns a list of people from search results.
    - [Perform Companies Search](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/performclassiccompaniessearch.md): Returns a list of companies from search results.
    - [Perform Jobs Search](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/performclassicjobssearch.md): Returns a list of job postings from search results.
    - [Perform Posts Search](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/performclassicpostssearch.md): Returns a list of posts from search results.
    - [Perform Classic Search from URL](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/performclassicsearchfromurl.md): Returns a list of results from a LinkedIn Classic search URL.
  - Classic Job Posting
    - [List User Job Postings](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listclassicuserjobpostings.md): Returns a list of job postings created by the current user.
    - [Get a Job Posting](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getclassicjobposting.md): Retrieves a job posting by its ID.
    - [Get the Budget for a Job Posting](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getclassicjobpostingbudget.md): Returns available budget ranges, recommended budgets, and estimated impact.
    - [Create a Job Posting Draft](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/createclassicjobpostingdraft.md): Creates a new job posting as draft.       Use <a href="https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/publishclassicjobposting">Publish a Job Posting</a> to publish the job once you are ready.
    - [Edit an existing Job Posting](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/editclassicjobposting.md): Edits a job posting created by the current user.
    - [Publish a Job Posting](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/publishclassicjobposting.md): Publishes a job posting with specific budget options.
    - [Close a Job Posting](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/closeclassicjobposting.md): Closes a job posting so applications cannot be submitted anymore.
    - [Get an Applicant](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getclassicapplicantbyid.md): Retrieves an applicant by ID.
    - [Get an Applicant's Resume](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getclassicapplicantresume.md): Downloads the resume of a given applicant.
    - [List Job Posting Applicants](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getclassicapplicants.md): Returns a list of the applicants to a job posting.
  - Recruiter Projects
    - [List Projects](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getrecruiterhiringprojectlist.md): Returns a list of hiring projects created in the current contract scope.
    - [Get a Project](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getrecruiterhiringproject.md): Retrieves the specified hiring project.
    - [List Pipeline Candidates](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getrecruiterpipelinecandidates.md): Returns a list of candidates from the pipeline of a project.
    - [Create a New Project](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/createrecruiterhiringproject.md): Creates a new project in the current contract.

  - Recruiter Search

## API Reference: PLATFORM
- Accounts
  - [Get an Account](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getaccount.md): Retrieve an Account. After successful Hosted Auth authentication with initial sync waiting enabled, the consumed session can retrieve only its linked account until its polling deadline.
  - [Remove an Account](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/removeaccount.md): Remove an Account from Unipile by its ID. This action is irreversible and will remove all data associated with the Account.
  - [Update an Account](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/updateaccount.md): Update an Account by ID.
  - [List all Accounts](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listaccounts.md): Returns the Accounts accessible to the API Key in the current Application. Use `account_scope_id` with a Scope ID to return Accounts assigned to that Scope, or `none` to return Accounts without a…
  - [Synchronize an Account](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/syncaccount.md): Request a full history synchronization for an Account, including after an earlier synchronization completed. Currently supported for WhatsApp accounts. The response confirms that the request was…
- Scopes
  - [Create a Scope](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/createscope.md): Creates a Scope in the authenticated Application. A Scope is an isolation boundary used to restrict Account API Keys to the Accounts assigned to it.
  - [List Scopes](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listscopes.md): Returns the Scopes created in the authenticated Application, including their status and the number of Accounts and API Keys assigned to each Scope.
  - [Get a Scope](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getscope.md): Returns a Scope from the authenticated Application, including its status and the number of Accounts and API Keys assigned to it.
  - [Update a Scope](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/updatescope.md): Updates the name, unique reference, or status of a Scope. Disabling a Scope blocks its Account API Keys and authentication flows until it is enabled again.
  - [Delete a Scope](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/deletescope.md): Deletes a Scope from the authenticated Application. The Scope must not contain any Accounts or API Keys, including expired API Keys.
- API Keys
  - [Create an API Key](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/createapikey.md): Creates an API key that can access every account or only accounts assigned to one scope. Service API keys cannot be created through this endpoint.
  - [List API Keys](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listapikeys.md): Lists account-wide and scoped API keys. Service API keys are never exposed by this endpoint.
  - [Delete an API Key](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/deleteapikey.md): Deletes an account-wide or scoped API key. Service API keys cannot be deleted through this endpoint.
- Webhooks
  - [List all Webhook Conversations](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listwebhookconversations.md): Returns a list of all Webhook Conversations associated with the current Application. The conversations are returned sorted by their creation date, with the most recent appearing first.
  - [Create a Webhook Endpoint](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/createwebhookendpoint.md): Creates a new webhook endpoint.
  - [List all Webhook Endpoints](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/listwebhookendpoints.md): Returns a list of all Webhook Endpoints associated with the current Application.
  - [Update a Webhook Endpoint](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/updatewebhookendpoint.md): Updates a webhook endpoint by ID.
  - [Delete a Webhook Endpoint](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/deletewebhookendpoint.md): Deletes a webhook endpoint by ID.
  - [Get a Webhook Endpoint](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/getwebhookendpoint.md): Retrieves a webhook endpoint by ID.
  - [Replay a Webhook Event](https://developer.unipile.com/v2.0/reference/replaywebhookevent.md): Queues a new delivery of a stored event to all currently enabled endpoints listening to this event and matching its account, even after successful delivery. Uses the original event ID and payload,…
